title: Battle Mage Guide
subtitle: World of Warcraft: Forever · Beta
description: How to get the Cold Flame Saber in World of Warcraft: Infinite: Scroll of Saber, Blade of Sylvallain, the effects of this sword, why the level 20 cap in the Beta prevents you from equipping it yet, the second blade you can’t get yet, and every scroll deciphered by the mage using understanding, data from the Beta client.
html:
In "World of Warcraft: Infinite", mages have an exclusive skill: understanding. You decipher scrolls that many monsters drop, which give you buffs, familiars, and weapon charges. One of the sword scrolls transforms Shadowfang Keep's Blade of Sylvallain into the Cold Flame Saber: a mage sword that burns and freezes targets in melee combat. Players call the mage who fights with it a battle mage.

You can craft the sword in the beta, but you can't equip it yet: it requires level 21, and the beta level cap is 20, until Blizzard raises the cap to 30.

Cold Flame Saber

sword scroll— Keep deciphering untranslated scrolls until one of them gives you a sword scroll. It most likely comes from a scroll that requires understanding (15), but no one has confirmed it yet. Some test server players got it on the 119th scroll.

Baron Silvaline— Kill Baron Silvaline in Shadowfang Keep repeatedly until he drops the Blade of Silvaline. Teams with test server players played 12 times.

Cold Flame Saber— Use a scroll on the blade: it will transform into a Cold Flame Saber.

Both the scroll and the blade are bound after being picked up: the mage who deciphers the scroll also has to pick up the blade himself, so remember to ask your teammates to give it to you.

At level 20 you can pick up blades and craft sabers, but neither can be equipped: they both require level 21.

to frozen target
Each melee attack hitting a frozen target will cause an additional 98 points of fire damage (frost burn). The client does not list it scaling with spell power. In the video recorded by test server players, some players said that it will increase with spell power; we have not verified it yet.
How to freeze a target
While the sword is in hand, you can freeze the target with Frost Nova, or with Frostbite: it gives your cold effect a 15% chance to freeze the target for up to 5 seconds. Fingers of Ice makes your subsequent spells work as if the target is frozen; no one has tested whether it also triggers Frost Burn.
Spark Infused Scroll
The Cold Flame Saber is a sword, so the Spark Infusion Scroll works on it: when an enemy hits you with a melee attack, your Fire Blast cooldown has a chance to reset. The description says "Fire Blast", but it resets the cooldown of Fire Blast.
Ice Blade Infusion Scroll
The Ice Blade Infused Scroll also freezes a target on hit, but it is infused with a dagger, and mages cannot equip both a dagger and a sword at the same time. It cannot be paired with a sword.

second blade

The second scroll has the same effect on a level 57 dagger. Neither is available in the beta.

Scroll of Wit— Keep deciphering until you get the Wit Scroll. It most likely comes from a scroll that requires understanding (175).

Dark Dean Gading— Dark Dean Gardin drops the Witchblade in Scholomance: approximately once every eight kills in Classic.

unknown weapon— The weapons it makes are not yet in the beta client: they don’t have names, they don’t have stats, and we haven’t seen them anywhere.

understand

learn
Mage trainers teach you how to understand scrolls starting at 6th level. It's a standalone skill, like the profession, and Deciphering Scrolls will take it all the way up to 300.
untranslated scroll
They have meaningless names, such as "Scroll: KWYJIBO," and can only be read by mages. Many monsters will drop it: for the first type alone, Wowhead lists 200 monsters, each with a drop rate between 0.2% and 4%.
learn
Learned once an hour, consuming a Light Feather, giving you a bundle containing several scrolls. You Need a Library: Players find one in the inner ring of the Undercity's magical district. They learn to "learn" by giving a book to Garion Wendell in Stormwind or Owen Thadd in Undercity; see our library book guide for where the book is.
library bookshelf
Depending on the client, the Library Shelf can turn your camp into a library: you'll want to place it next to your campfire. Don't know how to obtain it yet.

Improve skills

There are four types of untranslated scrolls, each requiring a higher level of Comprehension skill. Once a scroll turns gray, it no longer improves the skill: it is replaced with the next one before the skill reaches the level at which it turns gray.

title: Cozy Sleeping Bag Guide
subtitle: World of Warcraft: Forever · Beta
description: Get a cozy sleeping bag in World of Warcraft: Infinite: Every stop from Westfall and Barrens to Thoradin's Wall, complete with maps, coordinates and rewards, plus how the sleeping bag and trail mix actually look in the beta client.
html:
The

comfortable sleeping bag returns in World of Warcraft: Infinite. Spread it anywhere, lie in it and rest: 1% more experience after one minute, up to 3% more after three minutes. The bonus lasts for two hours.

It follows the quest chain of the Season of Exploration, with no real quest giver: you have to find and click on a series of hidden objects across Azeroth, from Westfall and the Barrens all the way to Thoradin's Wall.

14 level can start this quest chain, both Alliance and Horde can. Along the way, you'll also pick up two 12-slot backpacks and a ranged weapon of your choice. This guide details each step, with map locations and rewards.

Task chain

This task chain will span two continents: the routes of ships and airships are on the world map. The numbers on each picture correspond to the steps below.

Western Wilds and Barrens

Each camp starts on its own continent and ends on another. The charred remains were the charred body of a traveler, with a nailed wooden board standing next to it.

Alliance

Scorched Wreck — In Westfall, click 37.4, 50.6 Scorched Wreck, located in the burned fields of Alexton's farm. This will begin... the note you found.

Scorched Wreck — Go to the Burnt Tower in the Barrens 46.4, 73.9, in the Giant Wilderness south of Camp Taurajo. Click on the charred wreckage or the studded planks to turn in the quest.

Nailed plank — Take the stepping stone from the nailed plank.

Horde

Scorched Wreck — In the Barrens, click on the Scorched Wreck at 46.4, 73.9, next to the Burnt Tower in Giant's Field. This will begin... the note you found.

Scorched remains — To the burned fields of Alexton's farm in Westfall, 37.4, 50.6. Click on the charred wreckage or the studded planks to turn in the quest.

Nailed Wooden Boards — Take the stepping stone from the Nailed Wooden Boards.

...The reward for the note you find

Potion of Swiftness

Lesser Troll Blood Potion

Stonetalon Mountains

Garbage Bag — The path leads to an abandoned campsite at 40.7 and 52.4. Click on the trash bag on the box next to the tent: hand over the stepping stone and start climbing over the mountain.

A pile of dirt — Climb up the hill to the north of the camp. There is a pile of dirt at 39.6, 49.9, and there is a gap to jump over. Click on it: Hand over the mountains and get down to the dirty work.

Optional: The fire pit in the center of the camp will begin to reignite. Use the Stepping Stone to light a fire with your regular firewood and flint and tinder, which will be returned to you. The task chain does not require this step.

Burning Sun Stone House is the stronghold of the tribe: Alliance players will pass near the guard.

Stepping Stone Rewards

Loch Modan, Stone Dam

Carved Statue — Walk out along the dam, facing the wetlands to the north, and jump to the dwarf head carved below the top of the dam. The carved statue was placed there.

Dirty Job — Click on it: Hand over the dirty work and begin Eagle Fist.

The dam is guarded by the Alliance: Horde players should be careful.

Reward for dirty work

Mahogany tube

Bright beauty Flavored Rum

Thoradin's Wall

Messenger's Bag — Go through the walled room and look outside on the right: the Messenger's Bag hangs there, 22.4, 24.2 (Arathi Highlands). Click on it: Hand over the Eagle Fist and start right here.

Hastily put away package — Click on the hastily put away package directly below. The quest chain ends here, and the cozy sleeping bag is yours.

That’s the bonus here

Comfortable sleeping bag

Mix Adjust the effect of dry fruit

Sleeping bag

Roll out the sleeping bag
You need to stand still for 15 seconds. The sleeping bag will be left on the ground for 20 minutes and can be laid out again after an hour.
Bonus
Every time you lie down for a minute, you will get a stack of full energy: 1% more experience points from kills and missions, up to 3 stacks. Energetic lasts two hours, twice the cooldown of a sleeping bag, so you can always maintain 3%: spread out your sleeping bag every one to two hours and lie down for three minutes.
Two hours, not one hour
Other strategies say the bonus lasts for one hour. In the Beta client it lasts two hours (7200 seconds), the same as Season of Exploration: one hour is the sleeping bag's cooldown.
Resting state
Some players said that lying in a sleeping bag is considered a resting state, just like being in a hotel. We haven't verified it yet.
Mixed dried fruits
Dry food on the road, not a rest experience. During the exploration season, eating it will also give rest experience. This effect is no longer available in the Beta client of "World of Warcraft: Infinite": now eating a handful will instantly restore 500 points of health, and then restore 1050 points within 12 seconds, and restore 900 points of mana, 50 points of rage or 100 points of energy. You can eat once every 5 minutes, and you can stack up to 30 pieces. Over the Mountain and the last mission will both give you some.

title: Crafting Speed Gear
subtitle: World of Warcraft: Forever · Beta
description: Special equipment in "World of Warcraft: Infinite" that can speed up professional manufacturing: blacksmith shorts and cookie soup sticks dropped from the Dead Mine, as well as the Arcanine blacksmith's hammer that is forged and can also be used as a blacksmith's hammer.
html:
"World of Warcraft: Infinite" adds many new tricks to professional skills, including a type of special equipment: wearing it can speed up smelting or cooking, and there is even a throwing weapon that is a blacksmith's hammer itself, which can save you a backpack slot.

They may not be able to improve much combat effectiveness, but they are the horizontal collection advocated by the unlimited server. Three are known so far, all listed below.

Equipment list

Source: Death Mine, dropped by Goblin boss Kilnig (about 55%), wearable at level 16.

Early mining benefits: After equipped, the manufacturing time of smelting copper ingots, tin ingots, bronze and silver ingots is reduced by 25%. Just put it on when crouching in the furnace and charging forward with skills.

Source: Cookie drop from the final boss of Dead Mine (about 35%), available at level 17.

The cooking artifact of the magic wand profession: after equipped, the cooking speed is increased by 25%, and it can be used from leveling up to full level without any problem.

Source: Forged, requires blueprint: Arcanite blacksmith hammer (forging 270, available at level 49).

It is a thrown weapon that may stun the target for 1 second on hit and "can be used as a blacksmith's hammer." After making it, the regular blacksmith's hammer that occupies the backpack slot can be thrown away.

title: Druid Cat Form Guide
subtitle: World of Warcraft: Forever · Beta
description: Let the druid learn cheetah form in "World of Warcraft: Infinite": the complete steps of the level 20 quest chain, the locations of Moonglade and Stormrage Lair, the three relic pickup mechanisms, and four skills taught by trainers for free.
html:
In "World of Warcraft: Infinite", the druid must complete a quest chain at level 20 to learn the cheetah form. The trainer will send you to Moonglade, where the Spirit of the Giant Leopard wants you to retrieve the three holy objects hidden in the Stormrage Lair. When you come back, the trainer will teach you cheetah form, stealth, claw attack, and tear all at once.

Night elves, tauren and skyborn elves each have a set of quest chains, with the same process and location. When you arrive at the Stormrage Lair, it is recommended to form a team with other druids on site: a holy object can be picked up by the entire team.

The entire task chain has a total of 2,885 experience points. Skyborn elves who join the High Order begin and end in Darnassus, and Windshaper Skyborn are in Thunder Bluff. Moonglade quests also reward Cenarion Circle reputation.

Stormrage Den

The entrance to the Stormrage Den is to the east of Moonglade Lake (71.2, 61.5).

Before entering the door, click on the statue at the door to obtain the "Leopard's Blessing of Silent Shadow": it allows you to sneak for five minutes and will not reveal itself as long as you are not in combat.

The souls in the beast's lair guard the sacred objects and will attack you if they see you. Once a soul sees through the stealth, immediately transform into bear form and kill it.

The three sacred objects are the fang sacred object, the claw sacred object and the silent shadow sacred object, which are only a few steps away from each other.

Team up with the surrounding druids: the holy objects are picked up for the team. When the holy objects are refreshed, each member of the team can get one. A group of five druids only has to wait for one refresh instead of five.

Click the holy object continuously until you start casting: the holy object will not be yours until the casting bar is full.

What you will learn

When you hand in the last mission, the trainer will teach you the following four skills for free.

Cheetah form (transformation)
55% base mana, instant. Transform into cheetah form, increase attack strength by 12 points, and additionally increase attack strength equivalent to agility value; at the same time, it is immune to the effect of transformation, and can use various cheetah skills. The moment of transformation will also remove the deformation and movement restriction effects.
Stealth (Level 1)
Instant cast, 10 seconds cooldown. Enters stealth state, but movement speed is reduced by 40%. The effect lasts until canceled.
Claw Strike (Level 1)
45 Energy, melee range, instant. Claws the enemy, causing 110% normal damage, plus 27 points of damage, and rewards 1 combo point.
Tear (Level 1)
30 Energy, melee range, instant. The finishing move causes the target to suffer continuous damage for a period of time. The damage is determined by the combo points and attack strength: 1 point - 44 points within 12 seconds; 2 points - 71 points within 12 seconds; 3 points - 97 points within 12 seconds; 4 points - 124 points within 12 seconds; 5 points - 150 points within 12 seconds.

After the mission

, the appearance of the cheetah can be changed: after wearing the five-piece fang suit dropped from the Wailing Cave, the cheetah will turn into a snake; the barber shop can also change the appearance of other cheetahs according to race.

title: Druid Snake Form & Druid Looks Guide
titleEn: Druid Snake Form & Druid Looks Guide
subtitle: World of Warcraft: Forever · Beta
description: Transform your cheetah form into a snake in World of Warcraft: Infinite: the drops and set effects of the five-piece Wailing Caverns Fangs set, the actual performance of snake form, and all 49 druid form appearances provided by race in the barbershop.
html:
After

wears all five pieces of the "Serpent's Embrace" leather armor set dropped from the Wailing Cave, the cheetah's form will transform into a snake - this is not mentioned at all in the set description.

Other forms of the druid also have a new appearance in the barber shop: a variety of colors are provided according to race, and the Skyborn elves also have exclusive elemental style forms.

Snake form

Snake form replaces the appearance of the cheetah form. The cheetah form requires the druid to complete the task chain at level 20 to learn it.

Five-piece fang set

Bind all five pieces after picking them up. Each druid must enter this brush by himself. The drop rate is classic old world data, which may have been adjusted in "World of Warcraft: Infinite".

This set is leather armor, and stalkers will also need it for the effect of the set. If there are Rogues in the party, agree on the assignment before fighting the first boss.

Set effect

Performance of snake form

Only the cheetah form will turn into a snake, while other forms such as bear form remain the same.

The coma of Dream Venom can interrupt the enemy's reading bar. According to actual tests, it can be triggered continuously. It seems that there is no cooling time.

When sneaking, the snake will slide close to the ground, but the sound will still be the meow and roar of a cat.

also maintains the appearance of a snake when swimming.

The snake form is implemented on the server side: it cannot be found in the set spells and barber shop data of the Beta client. The official may adjust it at any time without releasing a patch.

Other Appearances

ZXTAG004 There has never been an item in the 460-level version that can change the appearance of the druid form. This is the first time for the snake form, and there may be other sets in the future. The barbershop offers multiple looks for each form by race, and bears and cheetahs can also retain their classic old-world looks. As of October 1st, barbers will be available at barbershops in Darnassus and Thunder Bluff.

title: Library Books Guide

description: World of Warcraft: Infinite beta library book locations, maps, and rewards. Collect 10 different books to exchange for necklaces, a total of 20 books to exchange for rings, and 25 books to choose an equipment.
html:
Season of Exploration library books return to World of Warcraft: Infinite, along with new gear rewards. Collect different books from across Azeroth and bring them to the librarian in Stormwind or Undercity.

Hand over 10 different books in exchange for necklaces, a total of 20 books in exchange for rings, and 25 books to choose one of three pieces of equipment. There are only 16 books in the first set, so to get to 20, you need at least 4 books from higher level areas.

reward

Search books— Search for books These books are not dropped by monsters. Each one is picked up from a fixed object in the world: a bookshelf, a stack of scrolls, a book on the table, etc. There are 16 different books in the first set. Locations are listed below, with additional notes noted if the location comes from player feedback or still needs to be confirmed in World of Warcraft: Infinite.

Leave it to your librarian— Give your librarian a Charm of Understanding for each book you turn in. The following coordinates are used on the city map: Garion Wendell, Stormwind City, Mage District (37.6, 80.8), Owen Thadd, Undercity, Magic District (73.4, 33.0)

10 Books: Choose Your Necklace

Choose one of these two rewards. Both necklaces have no level or class restrictions.

Scholar's Pendant— Scholar's Pendant Item Level 25

Loremaster's Talisman— Loremaster's Amulet item level 25

20 books in total: Choose your ring

Choose a ring. The field researcher's ring is limited to rogues, and the great philanthropist's ring has no occupation restrictions.

The Ring of the Great Philanthropist— Great Philanthropist’s Ring item level 35

Field Researcher Ring— Field Researcher Ring item level 35

The first 10 books also count towards the ring: you need 20 different books in total, not 30.

25 books in total: choose one from three

Continue to hand in books and collect a total of 25 different books. You can choose one more piece of equipment from the following three pieces.

Truth Seeker's Bow— Truth Seeker's Bow item level 45

clarify emblem— Clarification of emblem item level 45

books of the eastern kingdoms

title: PvP Ranks & Honor
subtitle: World of Warcraft: Forever · Beta
description: How PvP ranks work in Warcraft Unlimited: how many rank points are required for each of the 14 ranks, which week each is open, what is unlocked, how to use honor to purchase blue and epic sets, and the level 30 Darkspear Islands.
html:
The 14 PvP military ranks of the original Warcraft have returned to the unlimited server. The alliance ranges from private to generalissimo, and the tribe ranges from scout to high-level warlord. Battlefields and PvP missions will give you two things: honors used to purchase PvP equipment, and military rank points used to upgrade PvP military ranks. Each new rank unlocks rewards that can be purchased.

You can't climb as fast as you want: the game will increase the highest military rank you can reach every week, and military rank 14 will not be available until the tenth week of the season at the earliest. In 2004, your PvP rank was determined by how many fights you played compared to other players on the server. In the infinite server, every player needs the same number of points.

The following will talk about: what is required for each military rank, what is unlocked, how to use honor to purchase PvP sets, and what level 30 can already do in the beta (the new 15 vs. 15 battlefield Darkspear Islands has been opened).

Honor and rank points
Both battlefield and PvP missions are given. Honor is used to purchase PvP equipment and can be held up to 25,000 points. Military rank points are used to upgrade PvP military ranks and will not be consumed.
It takes 24,750 military rank points to reach military rank 14
in ten weeks. The game will increase the highest military rank you can reach each week: in week 1 it is military rank 3, in week 5 it is military rank 8, and in week 10 it is military rank 14.
Each military rank has rewards
Military rank 1 has a jersey, military rank 2 has PvP accessories, military rank 11 has a black war mount, and military rank 14 has weapons.
Blue first, then epic
Blue PvP set can be purchased with honor, starting from level 55. At level 60, Mark of Fear can upgrade every piece of equipment to an epic version. The marks are different according to the parts, and are available for purchase from military ranks 8 to 13.

Honor and Set

Honor

Honor comes from killing players of the enemy camp, battlefields and PvP missions, and will go directly to your currency page. Can hold up to 25,000 points: Blizzard raised the cap from 15,000 on October 1, while also increasing most PvP prices by about 50%. The new price has not yet been announced.

Now each battlefield takes the same time to get similar honors, so Alterac Valley is no longer the only efficient battlefield. The inheritance expertise "Supreme Glory" can be increased by up to 10%.

First blue, then epic

Each set has a blue version that can be purchased with honor. Item level is 60 and can be purchased starting from level 55. PvP military rank is not required. The epic version is item level 65 and requires level 60: bring blue equipment and the fearless mark on the corresponding part, and each mark must reach the corresponding PvP military rank before it can be purchased.

Rank points come from the battlefield and missions released in Gadgetzan. Honor also comes from these places, and every honor kill is also given. Players from all server types will mix together on the battlefield, except for Hardcore mode.

Each week, one of the first three battlefields will take turns to become the "Call to Battle" battlefield, in order: Darkspear Islands, Arathi Basin, and Warsong Canyon. It will give more honor and rank points that week.

Land of Honor series of tasks

There are ten weekly tasks in each season, which will give honor and military rank points. Weeks 4, 7 and 10 will also give 1 inheritance point each, and these three will continue to be available in subsequent seasons. The content of the mission has not been released yet, but there are already these goals in the game:

12 inheritance points

Among the inheritance points a character can obtain, 12 points come from PvP, 1 point each:

  • Military rank 3, 7, 10, 13, 14
  • Achieve exalted reputation in each battlefield camp
  • Honorable Land Week 4, 7, 10

Darkspear Islands

This is a new battlefield, and it is also the only battlefield that can be queued by Beta. It can be queued starting from level 30. Fifteen versus fifteen, located on an island off the coast of Kalimdor: there are four strongholds to defend, and a flag in the middle to take back to your own stronghold. The first team to score 2,000 points wins. Don't go in the water: there are sharks. Don't go in the water: there are sharks.

For other level 30 gear, our Graduation Equipment List (BIS) has a PvP list for each class, and the Duel Tournament Guide covers the level 30 Horde Tournament on October 17th and 18th.

FAQ

Will PvP military rank decrease?
Blizzard doesn't mention decay, and there's nothing in the game that deducts points: your rank is a progress bar that only grows. Classic itself also canceled decay in December 2023.
Will my PvP military rank be reset every season?
Blizzard hasn’t said anything yet. The PvP tab will show the season and end countdown, and the lead designer said that military rank 14 can be reached "in a season or a version cycle", and the roadmap plans to have a PvP season update in the spring of 2027 and the summer of 2027.
When does the first season start?
has no date yet. The unlimited server launches on November 4th, and Blizzard has not said whether the first PvP season will start on the same day.
Do we have to fight Alterac Valley?
is not required. Blizzard has evened out the honors given by each battlefield. Alterac Valley cannot be opened until level 51, and it is not included in the "Call to Arms" rotation. However, it is still counted in the kill mission in the Land of Honor, and its camp reputation can also earn inheritance points.
Does PvP in the wild count?
will give honors for honorable kills anywhere. According to the game itself, military rank points come from battlefields and missions released in Gadgetzan.
What will happen if the rank points exceed the weekly limit?
Blizzard hasn’t said yet whether they will wait until the cap is raised next week before counting it in, or whether they will just void it.
Do I need a PvP military rank to buy a blue suit?
Not required. Blue equipment only requires level 55 and honor, nothing else is needed. PvP military ranks are limited to marks, military rank rewards and weapons.
Is there an arena or rated battlefield?
has not been announced yet. There are two arenas in the beta, Hyjal Crater and Glory Duel Arena, as well as a Battle of Gilneas map that Blizzard has not mentioned.

Source: Blizzard's official article on PvP progress (October 7), Darkspear Islands and inheritance system (September 23), the honor cap and price are from the Beta development notes on October 1; the rank points, weekly cap, rewards, marks, sets and battlefield data for each military rank are from the Beta client (version 1.60.1.70338).

title: Shaman Level 30 Weapons
subtitle: World of Warcraft: Forever · Beta
description: "World of Warcraft: Infinite" Shaman's level 30 career quest chain "Weapons of the Storm" rewards Lightning Grip, Tidecaller's Claw or Storm's Fury, plus the Elementalist's Bracers. This guide walks you through every step: from elemental aid, to storm, earth, and fire, to heeding my call, and finally to turning in the quest Basra the Windcatcher.
html:
Shaman has an exclusive quest chain at level 30. After completing it, you can choose one of three powerful weapons: Lightning Grip, Tidecaller's Claw or Storm Fury, and you can also get the Elementalist's Bracer. This quest chain is automatically opened after completing the Wind Totem quest.

The mission chain is divided into four steps: Elemental Aid → Storm, Earth and Fire → Heed My Call → Weapons of the Storm. You need to travel through many areas of Azeroth, and finally go to the Alterac Mountains to find Basra the Windcatcher to hand in the task.

Rewards

After completing "Weapons of the Storm", choose one of the following three weapons and obtain the Elementalist's Bracer.

Elemental Shaman's first choice: +6 intelligence, increase spell damage and healing by 46 points, lightning bolt critical strike +1%.

Healing Shaman's first choice: +5 endurance, healing effect +86, healing wave and secondary healing wave critical strike +2%.

Enhanced Shaman's first choice: two-handed hammer, +15 endurance +12 intelligence, storm strike damage increased by 10%.

Additional bonus shield: 1078 armor, 20 block, +9 stamina, +6 intelligence, and restores 2 mana every 5 seconds.

Task chain

This task chain is automatically opened after completing the Wind Totem task, with a total of four steps.

Step One: Elemental Aid

Go to Razorfen, kill the final boss Calgar Thornrib, and pick up the quest items.

Razorfen is located in the southernmost part of the Barrens, and the entrance to the instance is near 52, 89. Calgar Thornrib is the final boss of the dungeon and is level 27+. It is recommended to go as a team.

Step Two: Storm, Earth and Fire

Collect 20 elemental totems across Azeroth, distributed in the following areas:

Dustwallow Marsh — Collect the Great Land Totem

The Desolate Land — Collect the Fire Totem

Swamp of Sorrows — Collect water totems

Desolate land - Collect air totems

These totems come from elemental monsters and specific creatures in various areas. You can pick them up after killing them. Requires 5 of each type of totem, 20 in total.

Step Three: Listen to my call

Go to Thousand Needles Stone Forest and defeat the summoned level 40 elite elemental creature.

Mission summons multiple waves of elemental and quilboar enemies, culminating in a level 40 elite. It is recommended to complete it as a team at level 30, or try it alone after level 35.

Step 4: Weapons of the Storm

Take the collected totems to the Alterac Mountains and find Basra the Wind Catcher to hand in the task.

Basra the Windcatcher is located in the Alterac Mountains/way 80.4 66.8. He is the NPC who gave the Warrior the Whirlwind Ax. After completing the mission, you can choose one of the three weapons and obtain the elementalist's bracers.

Practical Tips

Team Formation Suggestions — Both Razorfen Dungeon and Thousand Needles Elites recommend teaming up. Level 30 is difficult to complete alone.

Weapon selection—Elemental sarc choose Lightning Grasp, heal sarc choose Tidecaller's Claw, enhance sarc choose Fury of the Storm. All three items are for the main hand/both hands, and you cannot hold two items at the same time.

Bracers Universal - The elementalist's bracers are an additional reward, do not occupy the weapon selection quota, and are applicable to any specialization.
